notes.title: GAME OVERHAUL
notes.content:
Hi everyone! For this Christmas we are reaching[b] version 2.0[/b] of the game, I rebuilt some aspects of the UI and changed the hit boxes, map layouts and other minor things... At the moment we have 9 levels, they are much more balanced than the previous maps, some of them are reimaginings of old maps and some are completely new. This first couple of maps are the "normal maps" next year I will expand them and create some "expert levels"

[b]There may be some bugs and level inconsistencies, so if you find any just let me know!
[/b]
[b]For anyone who buys the game this Christmas please do a review! Even if you don't like it, tell me what problems you are facing, why X or Y is bothering you, just let me know!

This is an ongoing project and I want it to be great![/b]

Follow or Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Nixxsz

Follow me on Twitter: https://twitter.com/Nixxsz1

notes.title: Last chance to get the game for free!
notes.content:
Guys![b] Tomorrow I will be releasing the final update to the final version of the game[/b], so today is your last chance to get the game for free...

[b]I will continue to support the game with bug fixes and minor updates[/b], but right now I'm really happy with the state of the game.

It's my first game and I want to make many more. I don't have many pretensions with sales figures for this game but if it can help me pay for the publication on steam I'll be happy...

I'm planning to make and release my next game this year. I don't know what kind of game it will be, but I'm thinking something like "Helltaker"? So if you like Mabel and AIA, they might as well be characters in this game...

[b]ALSO! I don't know when, but I'm planning 2 free DLC's for Nixxsz Castle...[/b]

The first will be a "Tower" inspired by games like "Only up" and "Jump king".

The second is some sort of randomizer, not sure at the moment, but something along those lines...

notes.title: Patch notes June/2023
notes.content:
Hi, hope you are doing well!
In this patch I'm trying to fix some game issues and try new things...

[b]Fixes first...[/b]

- Fixed a bug that conserves momentum after character death.

Sometimes the character would retain some momentum or the last input from the controller even after death, causing him to move awkwardly.

- Increase the horizontal dead zone of the Controllers.

This change was made to make the game more friendly for controller users. This makes the character walk slower when slowly pressing the analog stick

- Add new action buttons for jumping.

This change might be a little weird, but I'm trying to fix the jump button on the controllers, and since I don't have a original controller myself, I just added 3 jump buttons, hope one of them is comfortable for you...

[b]Also, if you play with a controller, please let me know which controller you are using and also which buttons you can use to jump in this new patch...[/b]

[b]New things:[/b]

- The 7th trophy has been added so anyone can  100% the game as it stands right now... but remember that new levels are coming soon...

- Mabel's new "super power!"

Mabel can now transform into a platform to help players traverse the castle...

One of the biggest criticisms of the game is its difficulty. The game was made to be very difficult, it was inspired by kaizo, meat boy, celeste and other games that are "difficult", BUT maybe I'm not presenting the difficulty of the game in the right way... I'll make more introductory levels so that everyone can get familiar with the controls before it gets too difficult... Until these levels are done, Mabel will help you finish the game.

[b]Please note that difficulty is one of the main features of my game, but frustration doesn't have to be, if you find it more fun to play with Mabel as your pocket platform then do this! Get the trophies, finish the game, have fun, and when you're ready to challenge yourself, play without assistance mode...[/b]

[b]That's it folks, I hope these changes make the game better, and if they don't let me know... I'm always reading the discussions on the game's forum...[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574212/2bbe2d3e8fc8de05806277dad16237dcf6ed004e.png[/img]

notes.title: 3 BIG ANNOUNCES
notes.content:
Hey guys!

Recently I had more time to work on the game and I was a little dissatisfied with the state of it, many people pointed out that the controls were bad or not very intuitive and I think I managed to solve the problem, but I disabled the character's "Dash" until I figured out how to improve it. lo...

I would like to announce 3 big changes to the game

1 - This week I'm working full time on the game and if everything goes well by the end of next month I can "finish" it...

There will be [b]16 very difficult platforming levels[/b]

2 - Next week I will release 4 levels of the 16 promised levels and a UI with some updates for you to test

3 - Once the game is definitely released it will [b]becomes a paid application, it will cost 1 US dollar.[/b]

I don't know what the status of those who already own the game is, nor if it will be available for you to play or if you will have to buy it.

I'll see if I can create [b]steam keys for people who liked the game and wrote reviews[/b], BUT [b]I can't guarantee that, but I'll try![/b]

These announcements are part of my planning and may change if something happens, I'm not a professional Game Dev, but I'm doing my best to bring a cool experience to all of you...

Stay safe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574212/2bbe2d3e8fc8de05806277dad16237dcf6ed004e.png[/img]
